About the Collection

Golden Pixels is a digital art collection born from one simple idea: even the smallest light can look grand in the middle of darkness. Every piece is built from thousands of golden and white pixels arranged like a wave — some dense and glowing bright, others scattered and fading into stardust.

Every piece speaks the same visual language: pure black as the stage, gold as the light. No two pieces are identical — each edition is 1 of 1, the only one in the world, with ownership recorded on the blockchain as an NFT.

The collection started in the USA, is made one piece at a time, and grows slowly — putting character into every pixel, not chasing numbers.

How to Buy

Every Golden Pixels piece is 0.003 ETH. Payment for a sale goes to the one official seller wallet below — always check the address character by character before you send anything.

STEP 1

Set Up a Wallet

Install a crypto wallet such as MetaMask and top it up with enough balance to cover the artwork's price plus network gas fees.

STEP 2

Check the Seller Wallet

Copy the official seller wallet below and compare it in your wallet app before paying. If an address differs by even one character, do not pay.

STEP 3

Complete the Purchase

Buy through the marketplace listing when it is live, or pay 0.003 ETH to the official wallet for the piece you want and keep your transaction hash as proof. You receive the full-resolution master file with the NFT — this website only ever shows the watermarked preview.

FAQ

Straight answers before you buy.

What exactly do I buy?

Ownership of the unique NFT on Ethereum, recorded in your wallet, plus the full-resolution master file of the artwork delivered to you after purchase.

How do I buy a piece?

Click “Buy on Rarible” on the artwork, connect your wallet on Rarible, and complete the purchase there. This website never takes payments directly.

Who pays the minting gas?

These pieces use free (lazy) minting: the artwork is minted to your wallet at the moment of purchase, and the buyer covers the mint gas shown on Rarible at checkout.

How do I know a listing is genuine?

Only buy through the buttons on this official website, and check that the seller wallet is 0xa3f7c87a727e07a5d9ed4205c0405abbb4200ebb. Copies or screenshots of the image are not the NFT.

Will there be more copies later?

No. Every Golden Pixels artwork is 1 of 1 — no copies, no re-mints, no second editions.
